title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables scalable transfer of regulatory sequence models to novel contexts.
summary: Beyond transfer efficiency benchmarks, the study applies learned regulatory model to a specific fine-mapped variant with cell-type-resolved predicted ITGA4 effects, a concrete biological variant interpretation. Label as computational prediction pending direct functional validation.
